_header.description: Numeric baselines for the high-risk advisory scanners listed in BASELINED_SCANNERS (check-scanner-baselines.mjs). A count above the baseline fails check:scanner-baselines (new suspects must be fixed or the baseline consciously re-registered).
reRegistrationNotes: 2026-10-27 plan 769 (ai-debugger-copilot AD-1): find-async-without-failure-path 348 -> 349 (+1 net; raw listing shows 3 catch sites in the one new file, Found-count delta is the registered contract). New file packages/nop-debugger-ai/src/create-debugger-ai-tools.ts toolExecutor: three catch blocks intentionally normalize tool failures into structured { ok:false } ToolExecutionResult returns — the returned result IS the failure path (raw error text never rethrown or shipped to the model, owner-doc §Tool Surface Security), same intentional-shape family as the plan-757 lifecycle-primitive / plan-528 drag-ghost registrations.

2026-10-26 plan 757 (roadmap PH-4): discover-audit-suspects 787 -> 793 / find-async-without-failure-path 342 -> 348 (+6 each, same files). The six new hits are the async-lifecycle primitives themselves (packages/flux-core/src/utils/lifecycle/write-drain.ts:20,24 then-chain management; exit-resets.ts:14,24 body awaits with intentional swallow-and-rethrow semantics; link-disposal.ts:34 generator .return() swallow-by-design). Failure handling IS the contract of these utilities — the flagged shapes are the framework's own registered semantics (settle-tail bookkeeping, error cause attachment, teardown-stall prevention), mirroring the supports-passive bare-catch registration precedent.

2026-10-26 plan 755 (roadmap PH-2): find-missing-renderer-markers 0 -> 15 — the FALSE ZERO is fixed. rules.mjs scanMissingRendererMarkers no longer treats any `nop-` substring (satisfied by every @nop-chaos/* import) as a whole-file exemption; new criteria = (1) RendererComponentProps present, (2) no marker literal matching /(?<![@\w/.-])nop-(?=[a-z0-9]|\$\{)/, (3) file contains a host-element JSX tag (HOST_ELEMENT_TAGS). Registered at the live recount 15: flux-renderers-data table-renderer sub-components x7, form hidden-renderer/input-suggest, form-advanced input-table-row/tree-control-pipeline/upload-field, layout resizable-renderer/wizard-step-body/wizard-step-nav. Triage of these 15 belongs to each renderer owner surface (ratchet, not zero-new, per roadmap PH-2). Same-source double count: discover-audit-suspects aggregates every rule bucket, so it moves 772 -> 787 (+15, identical file set) — no new suspects beyond the marker family. Hand-edited.
